title: opto-sync envelope for a route map
description: The RPC/route-map system publishes the *contract* (route map) into opto-sync. RPC call/receipt frames are a different document and must not be stuffed into this envelope. opto-sync must not depend on ores-api-docs; this crate must not depend on opto-sync-client. Identity key is `id`; Last-Write-Wins keys are `updatedAt,syncedAt` — the same defaults as github.com/opto-sync/opto-sync-clients. If opto-sync speaks TCP, it may carry opaque NDJSON that happens to be an rpc-call frame; that is coincidence of JSON, not a type import.

id.description: opto-sync array/object identity. Equal to record_id.

updatedAt.description: Digit-string or RFC 3339 timestamp. Digit strings survive JS Number rounding; see opto-sync-clients README.

payload.description: The route-map document (keys → routes, transports, typed query/path/body schemas).
